source.title: City Government of Batangas Citizen’s Charter 2026 (2nd Edition)
source.pageNumbering: PDF page numbers match the printed charter page numbers. Read the service pages directly; the table of contents has a market-stall page typo.

mayor.name: Office of the City Mayor
mayor.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City

mac.name: Mayor’s Action Center
mac.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City

bplo.name: Business Permits and Licensing Office
bplo.address: BayMall, 4th Floor, Barangay 14, P. Burgos corner D. Silang, Batangas City
bplo.locationNote: On-site business applicants present the appointment Transaction Slip at Receiving Window R1 in the Filing and Assessment Area (p. 86).

tdro.name: Transportation Development and Regulatory Office
tdro.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City
tdro.locationNote: Some inspections and sticker placement occur at the Grand Terminal; the office address is not an inspection-site address. See the specific transaction before travelling (pp. 120–140).

osca.name: Office for Senior Citizens Affairs
osca.locationNote: The directory does not specify a building, floor or street for OSCA; do not assume a City Hall counter.

registrar.name: Office of the City Civil Registrar
registrar.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City
registrar.locationNote: Local-copy requests start at the Public Assistance and Complaint Desk (PACD), Ground Floor, CCRO Building; submit the form and receipt at Window 1 or 2 (pp. 400–401). PSA BREQS requests use Window 3 (pp. 404–405).

accountant.name: Office of the City Accountant
accountant.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City

assessor.name: Office of the City Assessor
assessor.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City
assessor.locationNote: Tax declarations and assessment records do not substitute for transfer or registration of a land title.

budget.name: Office of the City Budget Officer
budget.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City

cdrrmo.name: Office of the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Officer
cdrrmo.address: Sang Virgen Street, Barangay Bolbok, Batangas City
cdrrmo.locationNote: This is the office address; emergency response is dispatched to an incident location.

engineer.name: Office of the City Engineer
engineer.address: Office of the City Engineer, P. Hererra, Barangay Kumintang Ibaba, Batangas City
engineer.locationNote: The directory spells the street “P. Hererra”. Building/occupancy transactions use the One-Stop Shop for Construction Permit (OSCP); the charter does not establish a separate OSCP street address. Confirm the receiving counter before travelling.

enro.name: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources Officer
enro.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City
enro.locationNote: City ENRO and DENR Community ENRO are different offices. Some city services provide an endorsement to DENR rather than the final national permit.

gso.name: Office of the City General Services Officer
gso.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City

health.name: Office of the City Health Officer
health.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City
health.locationNote: This is the administrative office address, not a promise that every clinical service occurs at City Hall. Confirm the assigned barangay health station/clinic and schedule with the Nursing Division for immunization and prenatal care (pp. 697–699).

hr.name: Office of the City Human Resource Management Officer
hr.address: 2nd Floor, Bagong Pag-asa Building, M.H. Del Pilar Street corner P. Dandan Street, Barangay 2, Batangas City

market.name: Office of the City Market Administrator
market.address: Julian Pastor Memorial Market, Batangas City
market.locationNote: This is the Market Administrator’s office address. The charter does not establish the street address of the slaughterhouse operating site.

planning.name: Office of the City Planning and Development Coordinator
planning.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City

cswdo.name: Office of the City Social Welfare and Development Officer
cswdo.address: Sang Virgen Street, Barangay Bolbok, Batangas City

treasurer.name: Office of the City Treasurer
treasurer.address: Batangas City Hall Complex, P. Burgos Street, Barangay 17, Batangas City

agriculture.name: Office of the City Agriculturist
agriculture.address: OCVAS, Sang Virgen Street, Barangay Bolbok, Batangas City

veterinarian.name: Office of the City Veterinarian
veterinarian.address: OCVAS, Sang Virgen Street, Barangay Bolbok, Batangas City
veterinarian.locationNote: The directory repeats “Office of the City Agriculturist” for the veterinary row. Its veterinary contact and the service headings on pp. 772–824 identify the veterinary service; this transcription discrepancy is retained in the review.

services.finding: Local certification is a different transaction from birth registration and from requesting a PSA copy. Follow the complete local-certification checklist on pp. 400–401.
services.publicSummary: Request a local copy of a birth record through the City Civil Registrar. Local copies, birth registration and PSA copies have different application routes.

services.recommendedTitle: Marriage Registration, Local Copy and Marriage License
services.finding: Split registration, local-copy certification and marriage-license applications; they have different checklists and processing periods.
services.publicSummary: Choose the transaction you need: marriage registration, a local certified copy, or a marriage-license application. Each has its own checklist and processing period.

services.finding: Separate health certification, civil registration, local copies, transfer of human remains and TDRO burial permits; one process cannot cover all five.
services.publicSummary: Civil registration and local copies are handled by the City Civil Registrar. Health certification, transfer of remains and burial permits are separate transactions with other offices.

services.finding: General barangay clearance belongs to the relevant barangay; do not invent a single citywide address. Business-permit barangay clearance is integrated into the city permitting process (pp. 86, 88). This charter is not evidence for a generic barangay fee/checklist.
services.publicSummary: Contact your own barangay for a general barangay clearance. For city business registration, barangay clearance is integrated into the permitting process described in the Charter.

services.finding: Refer to the resident’s barangay. The charter lists reissuance of barangay/SK official IDs (p. 111), not a universal resident barangay-ID service. No barangay-specific address or program is established here.
services.publicSummary: Ask your barangay whether it issues resident IDs and where to apply. The Charter’s barangay/SK official-ID service does not establish a general resident-ID program.

services.finding: Not established as a city-government transaction in this charter. PNP must confirm its current application channel and service counter; the police hotline listing is not evidence of a clearance-processing location.
services.publicSummary: Contact the Philippine National Police for its current clearance application channel and processing location. This City Charter does not establish a city-government police-clearance service.

services.finding: BPLO; distinguish on-site application from the online route and observe OSCP compliance/tagging conditions.
services.publicSummary: Apply through BPLO for on-site new business registration. The Charter describes an appointment Transaction Slip and OSCP compliance or tagging conditions.

services.finding: BPLO renewal, not a generic municipal-license process.
services.publicSummary: Apply through BPLO for on-site business registration renewal. Consult the renewal checklist rather than the new-business checklist.

services.finding: The charter places issuance of the Closure Certificate with the City Treasurer’s Administrative Division, not BPLO alone. BIR/SSS closure obligations remain separate.
services.publicSummary: Request a Closure Certificate from the City Treasurer’s Administrative Division. Closure requirements of BIR, SSS and other agencies are separate.

services.finding: City Health Officer — Environmental Sanitation Division; distinguish from an individual health certificate.
services.publicSummary: Apply for a new or renewed sanitary permit through the City Health Officer’s Environmental Sanitation Division. This is separate from a worker’s health certificate.

services.finding: Treasurer; do not route generic cedula applications to the Market Administrator.
services.publicSummary: Request an individual or corporate Community Tax Certificate from the City Treasurer. Requirements and assessment depend on the applicant type.

services.finding: OSCA issues the ID; new issuance, replacement, correction and cancellation are separate transactions.
services.publicSummary: Apply through OSCA. New issuance, replacement of a lost card, correction/change of address, and cancellation have separate procedures.

services.finding: CSWDO; other benefits/devices are separate services and are not automatic upon ID issuance.
services.publicSummary: Apply through CSWDO for a Persons with Disability ID. Assistive devices and other benefits have separate eligibility and application requirements.

services.finding: Replace a generic cash-aid promise with the applicable AICS special-case, medical or funeral service. CSWDO and MAC have different programs/checklists; approval is not guaranteed.
services.publicSummary: CSWDO and the Mayor’s Action Center have different crisis-assistance programs. Ask which medical, funeral or special-case service applies; assistance is subject to assessment.

services.finding: Both CSWDO AICS and MAC have documented funeral-assistance routes. Present them separately rather than merging eligibility or amounts.
services.publicSummary: Funeral assistance is documented under CSWDO AICS and the Mayor’s Action Center. Check the appropriate program’s eligibility and checklist before applying.

services.finding: CSWDO Family Welfare Program; requirements depend on the applicant’s qualifying circumstances.
services.publicSummary: Apply through CSWDO’s Family Welfare Program. The required supporting documents depend on the applicant’s qualifying circumstances.

services.finding: Nursing Division; routine, school-based and anti-rabies vaccination have separate entries. Do not promise all vaccines or a fixed vaccination venue.
services.publicSummary: Contact the City Health Officer’s Nursing Division for routine immunization, school-based vaccination or anti-rabies services. Confirm the assigned clinic and schedule before visiting.

services.recommendedTitle: Health Certificate for Food and Non-Food Handlers
services.finding: Environmental Sanitation Division; different from a medical certificate after consultation (p. 689).
services.publicSummary: Food and non-food handlers apply through the Environmental Sanitation Division. A health certificate for workers is different from a medical certificate after consultation.

services.finding: Separate CSWDO AICS, MAC hospital/medicine/chemotherapy support and Healthcard hospital-confinement referrals; financial support is not a general medical consultation.
services.publicSummary: Check the appropriate CSWDO, Mayor’s Action Center or City Healthcard program for hospital, medicine or treatment support. These are separate from ordinary medical consultations.

services.finding: Nursing Division; Mother and Child Book is listed. The charter states no fee and 55 minutes, but does not establish a universal clinic address/schedule.
services.publicSummary: The Nursing Division provides prenatal assessment and care. Bring the Mother and Child Book listed in the Charter and confirm the assigned clinic and schedule.

services.recommendedTitle: Real Property Tax Assessment and Collection
services.finding: Treasurer RPT Division; assessed value, penalties and exemptions depend on the transaction. Do not invent a citywide flat fee.
services.publicSummary: The City Treasurer’s Real Property Tax Division handles assessment and collection. Payment due depends on the property assessment and applicable charges.

services.recommendedTitle: Business Registration Tax and Fee Assessment
services.finding: Business fees are assessed within registration/renewal. Do not publish an unsupported standalone payment workflow or fixed tax amount.
services.publicSummary: Business taxes and fees are assessed as part of the relevant BPLO registration or renewal transaction. Check the applicable transaction and assessed amount before paying.

services.recommendedTitle: Real Property Tax Clearance / Cancellation of Warrant of Levy
services.finding: The documented service concerns real-property taxpayers; it is not BIR national tax clearance.
services.publicSummary: Request real-property tax clearance or cancellation of a warrant of levy from the City Treasurer. This is different from a national BIR tax clearance.

services.finding: No generic agricultural-loan product is established. Cooperative financial assistance and livestock dispersal/loan repayment are documented but are not interchangeable with the template loan promise.
services.publicSummary: This Charter does not confirm a general agricultural-loan product. Ask the City Agriculturist about specific programs; cooperative assistance and livestock dispersal have different eligibility.

services.finding: The documented city route serves RSBSA-registered livestock raisers. The template’s generic crop-insurance claim is not established; do not substitute livestock eligibility for crop coverage.
services.publicSummary: The documented city assistance route covers RSBSA-registered livestock raisers applying to PCIC. Crop coverage needs separate confirmation and must not be assumed from the livestock program.

services.finding: The documented service is a request for farm inputs for individuals/groups. Do not promise a permanent fertilizer subsidy, fixed allocation or entitlement.
services.publicSummary: Request farm inputs through the City Agriculturist’s Crops Production Division. Availability, assessment and the requested inputs determine the applicable assistance.

services.finding: Simple, complex and highly technical transactions have different requirements and timelines. Coordinated OSCP processing includes multiple offices; do not reuse one generic engineer checklist.
services.publicSummary: Apply through OSCP using the correct simple, complex or highly technical transaction. The checklist and processing period depend on the application classification.

services.finding: OSCP, with complex and highly technical routes; simultaneous building/occupancy applications are separate (p. 861).
services.publicSummary: Apply through OSCP for the appropriate Certificate of Use/Occupancy transaction. Complex, highly technical and simultaneous building/occupancy routes differ.

services.recommendedTitle: Repair and Maintenance of Public Infrastructure
services.finding: City Engineer Maintenance Division; scoped to roads, bridges, schools and other public infrastructure, not a promise to repair any private road.
services.publicSummary: Request repair or maintenance of public roads, bridges, schools and other public infrastructure through the City Engineer’s Maintenance Division.

services.recommendedTitle: City Scholarship and Financial Assistance Program
services.finding: MAC; first application and renewal differ. Follow the charter’s category and eligibility rules; do not retain a generic Mayor’s Office scholarship checklist.
services.publicSummary: The Mayor’s Action Center administers the documented City Scholarship and Financial Assistance Program. New applications and renewals have different checklists.

services.finding: Route the existing generic student-aid record to the documented MAC program. A blanket CSWDO student subsidy is not established by this charter.
services.publicSummary: The documented student-aid route is the Mayor’s Action Center scholarship and financial-assistance program. Check the applicable student category and eligibility.

services.finding: CDRRMO Operations and Warning Division; emergency response, scheduled medical conduction and event deployment are separate services.
services.publicSummary: CDRRMO handles emergency response. Scheduled patient transport, emergency clearing, water rationing and event-response deployment have separate request routes.

services.recommendedTitle: DRRM Training, Drills and Risk Services
services.finding: Different requests cover training, drills, risk assessment, hazard certification and plan review; requirements depend on the service.
services.publicSummary: CDRRMO provides separate services for drills, training, risk assessment, hazard certification and plan review. Select the specific request before preparing documents.

services.finding: Distinguish City Environmental Certificate (CEC), the city environmental clearance and DENR-EMB ECC/CNC; these are not one interchangeable permit.
services.publicSummary: City ENRO issues several different city environmental documents. A City Environmental Certificate or city clearance does not replace a DENR-EMB ECC/CNC where required.

services.recommendedTitle: Tree Pruning/Cutting Approval or DENR Endorsement
services.finding: The city has documented approval and clearance routes. The clearance certificate is an endorsement to DENR-CENRO; confirm which route applies to the tree and land.
services.publicSummary: City ENRO has separate pruning, cutting-approval and DENR-endorsement routes. Confirm which applies to the tree and property before cutting.

services.finding: Market Administrator collects rental fees from registered lessees; City Veterinarian handles meat inspection and meat-handler licensing. Per-animal slaughter prices and operating-site address are not established by these entries.
services.publicSummary: The Market Administrator handles rental-fee collection for registered lessees. Meat inspection and meat-handler licensing are separate City Veterinarian services. Confirm the operating-site address before bringing animals.

services.recommendedTitle: City Social Welfare and Development Services
services.finding: Use CSWDO and the specific program; remove blanket benefit claims and separate MAC/OSCA responsibilities. The charter does not list every former template program under these names.
services.publicSummary: CSWDO handles specific welfare, crisis, disability, family and livelihood services. OSCA and the Mayor’s Action Center have separate responsibilities and programs.

services.recommendedTitle: Environmental Complaints, Hauling and Clean-up Requests
services.finding: The charter documents environmental complaints, hauling approvals, septic certification and GSO clean-up support. A citywide household collection schedule is not established; do not invent collection days or a pickup counter.
services.publicSummary: The Charter documents environmental complaints, hauling approvals, septic certification and GSO clean-up support. Confirm household collection arrangements separately; no citywide pickup timetable is established here.

services.finding: Use Office of the City Market Administrator. The TOC says stall awards start on p. 837; the actual heading starts on p. 827. Market stall awards, rental payments, clearances and repairs are distinct.
services.publicSummary: The City Market Administrator handles market stall leases, rental and entrance payments, clearances and repair requests. Each transaction has its own procedure.

services.finding: The service chapter calls this a Division and the service/directory calls it BPLO. Use BPLO for the public office and retain exact transaction titles in citations.
services.publicSummary: BPLO handles new and renewed business registration, contractor permits, Mayor’s Clearance and other documented business certifications and permits.

services.finding: TDRO issues and renews MTOP and handles changes/transfer/dropping. Correct the template BPLS/Sangguniang Bayan routing. Inspection and sticker locations can differ from the office.
services.publicSummary: TDRO handles motorized-tricycle inspection, Mayor’s permits and MTOP issuance, renewal, change, transfer and dropping. Confirm any Grand Terminal inspection or sticker-placement instruction before visiting.

services.finding: Use the city office/division for each transaction; some payment methods involve external providers. Never copy bank-account/payment instructions without a separate current verification.
services.publicSummary: The City Treasurer handles documented tax, certification, cedula and payment services. Follow the specific transaction and confirm payment instructions through the official office.

services.finding: The charter’s external service is certification of availability of funds/appropriation. The old obligation-request and SEF workflow tables are not established by this chapter; do not label them resident services.
services.publicSummary: The Charter’s external Budget Office service is certification of availability of funds/appropriation. This is a specific certification, not a general resident cash-assistance program.

services.finding: Documented services are contribution/loan-remittance and gross-payment/no-transaction certifications. Old voucher pre-audit, payroll and check-preparation tables are not established as these public services.
services.publicSummary: The City Accountant issues the documented remittance and gross-payment/no-transaction certifications. Employee payroll and internal voucher workflows are different processes.

services.recommendedTitle: Tax Declaration and Property Assessment Records
services.finding: Distinguish land transfers/segregation from building/improvement/machinery declarations, and tax-record updates from legal title registration.
services.publicSummary: The City Assessor handles tax-declaration and assessment-record transactions for land, buildings, improvements and machinery. A tax-record update does not register or transfer a legal land title.

services.finding: Assessor record changes after land reclassification differ from planning reclassification/rezoning (p. 289). City tax declarations do not establish land-title ownership.
services.publicSummary: Choose the applicable appraisal, tax-declaration, certification, annotation or mapping service. Planning rezoning and legal land-title registration are separate processes.

services.finding: Consolidate duplicate civil-registry overviews. CENOMAR/PSA copies are available through city BREQS assistance (pp. 404–405); the city is not the national certificate issuer.
services.publicSummary: The City Civil Registrar handles registration, local copies, corrections and other civil-registry transactions. PSA birth, marriage, death and CENOMAR requests are also documented through BREQS assistance.

services.finding: Separate OSCP permitting from road maintenance, technical requests and waterworks. Do not claim every construction permit is issued at City Hall.
services.publicSummary: OSCP handles construction permits. The City Engineer also provides documented public-infrastructure maintenance, technical and waterworks services with separate request procedures.

services.recommendedTitle: City Planning, Zoning and Development Services
services.finding: Use distinct zoning certification, sign permit, CZC, PALC/development permit, rezoning and occupancy-zoning routes rather than one locational-clearance process.
services.publicSummary: Select the applicable zoning certification, sign permit, CZC, PALC/development permit, rezoning, map or data request. Requirements depend on the exact planning transaction.

services.finding: Agriculture handles farm machinery, crops, cooperatives and home extension. RSBSA registration, fisheries and livestock-insurance assistance are listed under City Veterinarian, not a universal agriculture counter.
services.publicSummary: The City Agriculturist provides documented machinery, crops, cooperative and home-extension services. RSBSA registration, fisheries and livestock-insurance assistance are listed under the City Veterinarian.

services.finding: Replace the template’s general vehicle/heavy-equipment rental promise with the documented request/approval services. Some transactions are limited to city offices, barangays, schools or eligible institutions.
services.publicSummary: GSO provides approved support requests such as tables/chairs, equipment, clean-up, carpooling, towing and facility use. Eligibility may be limited to offices, barangays, schools or other specified applicants.

services.recommendedTitle: City HR — Recruitment, Employee Records and OJT
services.finding: Separate public job applications/OJT from employee-only records and internal leave applications. A general certificate of no pending administrative case is not established in this HR chapter.
services.publicSummary: City HR handles recruitment, employee-record certification and OJT requests. Employee-only leave and benefits processes must be distinguished from services open to applicants.

services.finding: The charter confirms end-to-end online registration/renewal, not a standalone generic billing service. Use the official portal listed on p. 86; live availability is not verified here.
services.publicSummary: The Charter documents online new registration and renewal, including assessment and payment. A separate general-purpose billing service is not established by those entries.

services.finding: Confirmed online route; observe OSCP compliance conditions. The charter lists the portal at business.batangascity.gov.ph/Batangas/OnlineServices/login; this is source confirmation, not a live portal test.
services.publicSummary: The Charter documents online new-business registration and lists the official BPLO portal. OSCP compliance conditions apply; current portal availability has not been independently checked.

services.finding: Confirmed online route; do not retain an unconfigured appointment/payment destination.
services.publicSummary: The Charter documents online business registration renewal. Use the official BPLO channel and its renewal checklist; current portal availability has not been independently checked.

services.originalTitle: Real Property Tax Online Billing & Payment
services.finding: The charter directs applicants through the official city website’s Online Real Property Payment feature. Do not infer a payment URL or publish bank-account details from another route.
services.publicSummary: The Charter directs applicants to the official city website’s Online Real Property Payment feature. Confirm payment instructions through the official site before paying.

services.finding: No standalone general Online Payment Order service was established in the charter’s treasury or business chapters. Do not provide an active payment button or invent an endpoint.
services.publicSummary: A standalone general Online Payment Order service is not confirmed by the reviewed Charter chapters. Confirm the appropriate payment channel with the City Treasurer.

additionalServices.finding: The City Health Officer’s Medical Services Division provides the documented free-consultation service. Confirm the assigned service location and schedule before visiting.
additionalServices.publicSummary: The City Health Officer’s Medical Services Division provides the documented free-consultation service. Confirm the assigned service location and schedule before visiting.

additionalServices.finding: The City Health Officer’s Pharmacy Division has a separate medicine-availment service. Check its prescription requirements and available medicines; financial assistance for maintenance medicine is a different MAC program.
additionalServices.publicSummary: The City Health Officer’s Pharmacy Division has a separate medicine-availment service. Check its prescription requirements and available medicines; financial assistance for maintenance medicine is a different MAC program.

additionalServices.finding: The Charter lists availment of fruit-bearing tree seedlings. Availability and the specific request must be checked with the Crops Production Division.
additionalServices.publicSummary: The Charter lists availment of fruit-bearing tree seedlings. Availability and the specific request must be checked with the Crops Production Division.

additionalServices.finding: The City Agriculturist lists separate plowing, harrowing, furrowing, post-harvest equipment and machinery-registration services. Use the checklist for the equipment or task needed.
additionalServices.publicSummary: The City Agriculturist lists separate plowing, harrowing, furrowing, post-harvest equipment and machinery-registration services. Use the checklist for the equipment or task needed.

additionalServices.finding: Cooperative assistance, machinery use, shared facilities and product-development support have separate applicant categories. These are not an unconditional livelihood grant.
additionalServices.publicSummary: Cooperative assistance, machinery use, shared facilities and product-development support have separate applicant categories. These are not an unconditional livelihood grant.

additionalServices.finding: Financial assistance for disaster victims is documented under CSWDO. CDRRMO emergency-response and risk services have separate purposes and procedures.
additionalServices.publicSummary: Financial assistance for disaster victims is documented under CSWDO. CDRRMO emergency-response and risk services have separate purposes and procedures.

additionalServices.finding: The reviewed CSWDO chapter does not establish the template’s social-pension service. Confirm the current program and administering agency before applying; this does not mean no pension program exists.
additionalServices.publicSummary: The reviewed CSWDO chapter does not establish the template’s social-pension service. Confirm the current program and administering agency before applying; this does not mean no pension program exists.

additionalServices.finding: The Charter does not establish a separate household recycling-program application. City ENRO can confirm current recycling arrangements; environmental complaints and information/education are documented services.
additionalServices.publicSummary: The Charter does not establish a separate household recycling-program application. City ENRO can confirm current recycling arrangements; environmental complaints and information/education are documented services.

additionalServices.finding: The City Health Officer’s Nursing Division lists STI/HIV-AIDS consultation. Contact the division to confirm the confidential service location and schedule.
additionalServices.publicSummary: The City Health Officer’s Nursing Division lists STI/HIV-AIDS consultation. Contact the division to confirm the confidential service location and schedule.
